name: Reconciliation
definition: Process of matching different documents submitted by parties to a trade.

System.name: System
System.definition: System which provides the reconciliation process.

Document.name: Document
Document.definition: Document submitted in a reconciliation process.

ReconciledTrades.name: Reconciled Trades
ReconciledTrades.definition: Trades which are reconciled with entries in an account.

Account.name: Account
Account.definition: Account for which a reconciliation process is performed.
